name: @gjsify/vad
description: Voice activity detection for GJS: Silero on sherpa-onnx, reporting when speech starts and when a stretch of speech has ended after 300 ms of silence. Takes PCM from @gjsify/media-capture or any async iterable of chunks, and downloads its model on first use instead of bundling one.

scripts.clear: gjsify clear lib tsconfig.tsbuildinfo tsconfig.types.tsbuildinfo test.gjs.mjs
scripts.build: gjsify run build:gjsify && gjsify run build:types
scripts.test: gjsify run build:gjsify && gjsify run build:test && gjsify run test:gjs

osNotes.linux: Needs the @gjsify/sherpa-native prebuild, which exists for linux-x64 only today. Without it available() answers 'unavailable' and createVad() throws with the package to install; hasVadBackend() is the quiet check.
osNotes.darwin: @gjsify/sherpa-native is not built for macOS yet, so there is no detector to drive. available() answers 'unavailable'.
osNotes.win32: @gjsify/sherpa-native is not built for Windows yet, so there is no detector to drive. available() answers 'unavailable'.
